label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Some good news first: Priya Bhatia joins us on Monday 16 November. She's a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) with nine years at a consultancy in Coventry, and she's the reason I can finally say this out loud — our turnaround problem is solved.

Which makes it a good moment to be honest about the last two months. Beam calculations and drawings were taking five to six weeks through September and October. That isn't good enough. Several of you waited far too long, a few were rightly unhappy, and one left a rather sharp review, which was fair.

One couple in Harborne had their builder standing on site waiting, steel already ordered. We got it to them in three days in the end, but only after they'd chased us twice. That shouldn't have happened.

The truth is the slow weeks were my fault. I said yes to too much work on my own. In October I was doing site visits during the day and calculations until midnight, and my wife took to calling the office "the other house."

From now on the target is 10 working days for beam calcs and drawings. That's what having Priya on board buys us, and I'm genuinely pleased about it.

One change I do need to tell you about. The free first site visit is ending. From 1 January 2027, first site visits cost £95, deducted from your fee if you go ahead with the work. If you've already booked a visit when this post goes up, it stays free whatever the date — no exceptions, no invoice.

The free visit has been a nice thing to offer, but about a third of them never turned into a job, and I'd rather spend that time on the jobs you've actually asked for.

If you're waiting on calculations at the moment, your job is moving. Message me directly if you want an update.

And when Priya turns up on site with me over the next few weeks, do say hello.
